readings.moment: The temple struck ten while Girard sat alone in the dining room after dinner.
Girard went out into the street to smoke.
The piano started in the salon just as Girard lit his cigar.
Girard heard faint quick bells from the master's window (twenty-six minutes to eleven).
Girard came back into the house (fourteen minutes to eleven).
The hall clock had just struck eleven when Girard came back into the house.
The hall clock's face showed two minutes past eleven when Girard came back into the house.

whereabouts: Came up from Le Locle to attend the dinner at the house.
Was at the dinner table with Madame Monnier, Félix Monnier, Dr Vauthier, the girl from the atelier, and the speaker.
Sat alone in the dining room with the brandy after dinner.
Was in the dining room when the temple struck ten.
Went out into the street to smoke at 10:21 by his watch.
Stood under the front windows of the house while smoking.
Was standing outside under the front windows when the piano started in the salon at 10:29.
Came back into the house at 10:46 by his watch.
Went straight up to Félix in the library after coming back into the house.
